text: GET /carts/{id} answers {id, additional_discount_percentage, lat, lng, cart_items: [{id, quantity, cart_id, product_id, product {...}}]}; a new cart has an empty cart_items list. DELETE /carts/{id} removes the cart (empty body). Error answers are {message}; a 422 also carries errors: {field: [messages]}

The web shop keeps a guest's cart in sessionStorage (cart_id, cart_quantity); the first 'Add to cart' (data-test=add-to-cart, quantity in data-test=quantity) sends POST /carts and then POST /carts/{id} {product_id, quantity}, later ones only POST /carts/{id}; the navigation's cart icon count is data-test=cart-quantity; the page announces the add in a role=alert

The cart page is /checkout (step 1): one 'table tbody tr' per product, in it data-test=product-title (name, with a trailing non-breaking space), product-quantity (a number input: read its value), product-price, line-price; the total is data-test=cart-total. It reads the cart from GET /carts/{id} with the id in sessionStorage, so a test fills the cart in the same browser session
